options.A: The Lamp's own name, in place of A Lamp Left Burning.
options.B: The place in the app where the Lamp lives: its members, the story of its work told in chapters, and the gallery of the colors it named.
options.C: The palette gallery alone: every color the Lamp named, who picked it and what the others said, released a few at a time.
options.D: The margins of each decision: the vetoes, runners-up and jurors' notes kept beside every choice.
options.E: The factory: the whole machine that proposes, renders, judges and keeps the ledger.
options.F: The chapters: the written story of how the Lamp made each decision.

originality.found: Searches for Marginarium return no product, app, brand, studio, book, band, shop or franchise using the word. The nearest kin are obscure: Marginariella, a genus of New Zealand brown algae (first named Marginaria, a name a fern genus already held), and Margin of the Strange, an adventure game by Future Cat Games under a different title. Neither is a widely known name, so neither is grounds for a veto.
originality.line: No product, shop or band answers to this word; its nearest kin is a New Zealand seaweed, which keeps to the sea.

medea.lives: It lives in the margin itself: a note a guest leaves beside an old page renews it for whoever reads next, as a Georgian host counts each guest a gift, though the word never says magic.
medea.line: Keep the night's work in the margin beside every choice, so the turn from old to new can be pointed to.

baba-yaga.lives: It lives in margin, the ink and ornamental border the word is built on, and a little in -arium, a cellar where things keep and ripen like wine in a qvevri, which is where my Georgian thread shows.
baba-yaga.line: The margin is where ink runs wild and little drawings sneak in; this word knows the way, so I allow it.

hedge-witch.lives: It lives in marginalia, the hand-drawn sprigs a herbal keeps beside its plants, and the Georgian kitchen garden's tarragon and marigold grow in that same margin.
hedge-witch.line: The best sprigs in every herbal were drawn in the margins, where nobody was watching. Name the margins.

moon.lives: In the margin itself: the dim edge beside the lit text, where small notes are written by one low lamp while the page sleeps, like light behind a carved balcony screen.
moon.line: Keep the notes in the margin, by one small lamp; the best work is done while the house sleeps.

snow-queen.lives: My idea lives in the -arium: a cold, orderly hall where each specimen is kept exact and still, while the margin itself is the crowded warmth I guard against.

veto.quote: mush, clutter, warmth that turns cloying
veto.why: Kept beside every choice, the vetoes, runners-up and jurors' notes would fill each decision's margin until the page is clutter.

snow-queen.line: Release the colors a few at a time, as snow settles, and keep the margin still.

robber-girl.lives: It lives in the margin root: the margin is where handmade, lived-in notes get scribbled, the way bold embroidery runs right to the edge of the cloth.

veto.quote: prissiness; the timid and the samey; politeness for its own sake; cruelty passed off as boldness.
veto.why: Swapping the Lamp's own warm, bold name for a glass-cabinet herbarium-style word is prissiness, a polite museum name chosen over the wild one it already has.

robber-girl.line: Keep the vetoes in the margin, where the loud ones scribble. A lamp that hides its arguments is only polite.

storybook.lives: It lives in the margins, where a reader inks notes and little drawings beside the text, as in the ornamented pages of Georgia's illuminated Gospels.
storybook.line: Every book worth turning has marginalia; let the Lamp's vetoes and jurors' notes live where a reader would write them.

enchanted-workshop.lives: It lives in the margins as working parts: a veto stops a decision and a runner-up can be picked up again, so the notes beside each choice are tools doing a job.
enchanted-workshop.line: Let the margins work: the notes beside each choice should be the tools that made it.

scholar.lives: It lives in 'margin': a note beside the text is where a careful reader checks the work, so the word promises the runners-up and vetoes kept beside every choice.
scholar.line: A careful reader checks the margin before trusting the text; keep the vetoes and runners-up there, beside each choice.

painter.lives: It lives in the palette gallery, where each color's notes hang at its edge like marginalia and the painting stays the hero.

veto.quote: anything that upstages the picture or overstays
veto.why: A place in the app with members, a chaptered story and a gallery would compete with the painting for the eye, and the story alone would overstay.

painter.line: Hang the colors a few at a time, like a courtyard's quiet walls: the picture stays the hero.

child-at-bedtime.lives: It lives in the margins, the small drawings and quiet notes beside each choice, with the hush an iavnana lullaby brings to a sleepy room.
child-at-bedtime.line: Tiny drawings in a book's edge, found at bedtime: yes, Marginarium, read it to me again.

glassblower.lives: It lives in the -arium: a calm room for keeping and looking, which fits B's native place, where quiet chrome and clarity meet old stone the way Tbilisi's Bridge of Peace meets the old town.
glassblower.line: Give the margins a room made of system chrome, and let the glass show the old stone beneath.

pirosmani.lives: It lives in marginalia, the small drawings and notes a loving hand leaves at a page's edge, though the -arium makes it sound like a museum's cold coat.
pirosmani.line: A margin is where a painter who loved the thing writes the small sheep he could not leave out.

emily-dickinson.lives: It lives in margin, the small room beside a line where a note tells the truth slant; the -arium is the herbarium's pressing, more ending than the idea needs.
emily-dickinson.line: A margin note keeps the whole truth, slant, the way a moon keeps the mountain it hangs over.

open-source-enthusiast.lives: It lives in the margins, where the notes beside each decision credit those who came before and stay open for anyone to read, like toasts at a shared supra table.
open-source-enthusiast.line: Keep the margins open: every note beside a decision honors who came before and shows how we built on them.

nutcracker.lives: It lives in the margin itself: marginalia are the small notes a careful hand leaves beside its work, which is where a mechanism with a heart would show that it means well, the way an old street clock lets its small figures play out a life.
nutcracker.line: A machine's heart shows in its margins: the little notes it leaves beside its choices, kind even when it said no.

balanchine.lives: Only in the margin itself, the wings where a dancer waits for the count; the -arium is a glass case that holds still, so the motion does not live in this word and the Georgian speed does not show in it.
balanchine.line: Name what enters on the count. Colors arriving a few at a time are dancers; a glass case only stands.

bulat-okudzhava.lives: It lives in the margins, the small penciled notes kept beside each choice, the way a family keeps its remarks in an old songbook; Georgia shows there too, in that habit of keeping, not in the word's Latin.

veto.quote: bombast; irony without heart; spectacle that drowns the human scale
veto.why: As the Lamp's own name it would trade a humble lamp for a grand Latin hall, and that grandeur is the bombast that drowns the Lamp's human scale.

bulat-okudzhava.line: Let each choice keep a friend's penciled note in its margin; that is where the heart is kept.

vetoes.why: Kept beside every choice, the vetoes, runners-up and jurors' notes would fill each decision's margin until the page is clutter.
